notes.title: Updated on March 22, 2022
notes.content:
v1.1.0


Fixes:

1. Fixed an issue where wall objects in the principal's office wall interaction puzzle in Twilight Sun Middle School would change even after completion.


Adjustments/Additions:

1. New story/decryption mode, now when playing the game for the first time or reset the story, the game mode selection window will pop up, players can choose the appropriate mode to play according to their acceptance of the difficulty of the game, all the current version of the save mode will default to story mode.


① Plot mode:

A. All operation interactions can be skipped

B. The prompt information in the memo is comprehensive and detailed

② Decryption mode:

A. All operations cannot be skipped

B. The memo contains only key information


2. Added the small eyes prompt function. Now all clickable interactive places in the scene have added the "small eyes" prompt. Move the mouse to the prompt range, and the clickable interactive places will display the "small eyes" prompt.

notes.title: 2022年3月14更新说明
notes.content:
V1.0.1版本更新内容

调整/新增内容：
1.调整/增加了游戏内备忘录的提示内容，现在可以更好的帮助陈歌解决谜题；
2.《暮阳中学》，《海明公寓》篇章新增2个成就；
3.《平安公寓》篇章取消篇章结尾未收集齐证物时，遭遇三宝叔问话会触发失败结局的设定改为继续正常结局但无法获得一个成就；
4.全篇章所有互动增加重置/跳过/退出功能；
5.游戏模式固定为窗口模式，取消窗口最大化功能。

修复内容：
1.修复《暮阳中学》篇章102教室挂钟互动，概率出现齿轮转动到正确位置后判定未成功的问题；
2.修复手动存档时在部分场景的存档图错误的问题。
